services.desc: When the California Theatre opened in 1927, Hollywood stars traveled to San Jose to celebrate the debut of this lavish 1,122-seat movie palace. Today, it stands as one of the best-preserved examples of a 1920s-era motion picture theater in the country, thanks to a remarkable $75 million restoration completed in 2001.Adorned with gilded details, decorative paintings, and intricate stenciling, the California Theatre provides a stunning backdrop for unforgettable events.
